task.goal: Build `wordfreq`, a small Node.js command-line tool that prints the N most frequent words in a text file, with tests and a README. Use only the Node.js standard library.
task.result: Built `wordfreq`, a Node.js command-line tool using only the standard library. Run it as `node wordfreq.js <file> [N]`; it defaults to 10 results, counts lowercase Unicode letter/number tokens while retaining internal apostrophes, ranks by descending frequency with alphabetical tie-breaking, and prints tab-separated word/count lines. Added `README.md`, exported `topWords` function, `sample.txt`, `wordfreq.test.js`, and an `npm test` script in `package.json`. Verified now with `node --test`: all 6 tests pass.
